def is_app_root_eligible(span: ReadableSpan) -> bool:
    """Return whether an exported span may be marked as an application root."""
    # If there is no parent or no instrumentation scope, we consider it eligible.
    if span.parent is None or span.instrumentation_scope is None:
        return True

    # Do not treat spans that are children of a span from the same instrumentation scope as app roots.
    parent_scope = getattr(span.parent, "instrumentation_scope", None)
    if parent_scope is not None and parent_scope.name == span.instrumentation_scope.name:
        return False

    return (
        span.instrumentation_scope.name,
        span.name,
    ) not in APP_ROOT_INELIGIBLE_SPANS
```
